# libretro.h

The libretro API header, from
[libretro/libretro-common](https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/blob/master/include/libretro.h).
It is MIT licensed; the license text is at the top of `libretro.h`.

Used by `oracle/` to load emulator cores at runtime. No core source or binary
is vendored.
